title: New Malden Emergency Help Points
summary: Offline guide to 24-hour A&E, urgent care, local hazards, and emergency supplies in New Malden.
content:
For any life-threatening emergency, always call 999 immediately (or 112).

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospital:
Kingston Hospital, Galsworthy Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT2 7QB.
- Travel: From New Malden railway station, it is approximately a 35-minute walk (1.7 miles) west along Coombe Road and Kingston Hill, or take bus 131 directly along Kingston Road/Coombe Road to the hospital stop on Kingston Hill.
- Major Trauma Centre: St George's Hospital, Blackshaw Road, Tooting, SW17 0QT (take South Western Railway from New Malden or Motspur Park to Wimbledon, then bus 57 or 131 towards Tooting).

2. Urgent Treatment Centre (UTC):
Kingston Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre, Galsworthy Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT2 7QB (open 24 hours for minor injuries and illnesses).

3. Local Area Hazards:
- Beverley Brook runs along the eastern edge near Motspur Park and the Hogsmill River skirts the southwest, creating river flood risks in nearby parks and adjacent residential roads.
- Road underpasses along the A3 Kingston Bypass corridor and rail bridges near Motspur Park station are vulnerable to localized surface flooding.

4. Essential Supplies During Outages:
Pharmacies and supermarkets located along New Malden High Street and Burlington Road can supply bottled water, basic medical supplies, and batteries.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
